source_text: Audierunt gentes et iratae sunt; dolores apprehenderunt habitatores Philisthiim. Timores praecurrunt evangelium. Fama transitus maris praevenit terram promissionis.
pass_a_gloss: Heard nations and angry they-were; pains seized inhabitants of-Philistia. Fears run-ahead gospel. Fame of-crossing of-sea precedes land of-promise.
pass_b_english: [[The nations heard and were angry; pangs seized the inhabitants of Philistia >> Bible:Exodus 15:14]]. Holy fear runs ahead of the gospel; news of the sea-crossing goes before the land of promise.
